## Product: KENBEI
- Value: 写真・残作業・進捗・日報を一本化し、残業につながる事務作業を減らす
- Intro: https://www.starklab.jp/works/kenbei
- App: https://app.kenbei.jp
- Signup (14-day free trial): https://app.kenbei.jp/signup
- Pricing:
  - 14-day free trial (no permanent free plan)
  - STANDARD: 39,800 JPY / month, up to 50 members
  - BUSINESS: 65,000 JPY / month, unlimited members
- Note: KENBEI is Stark Lab's own product, not a customer case study. Former name KenSapo redirects to /works/kenbei. /works list and DrawStock pages redirect away.
